description: OSMoGrid generates electrical grid models from OpenStreetMap and optional asset CSV inputs. The IE3 research group publishes Java and Scala source, a user guide and configuration files, with a focus on low-voltage networks. Users provide a regional OSM PBF extract containing boundaries, buildings, streets, land use and substations, plus voltage and asset-generation settings. The program writes CSV grid assets for a chosen area, supporting later power-flow simulation. Geographic coverage is whatever OSM region is supplied, while the result is a network snapshot, not a time series. BSD-3-Clause source is freely available. A limitation is that OSM completeness and inferred asset placement affect whether the generated network resembles an actual utility system; the guide warns that even small areas can generate large files. The tool supports synthetic distribution-grid planning and hazard exposure studies. The catalogue's model-pandapower could analyse a converted network, but conversion was not tested. No OSM extract was downloaded.
